title: Eggs Benedict
description: Eggs Benedict is a classic continental breakfast featuring toasted English muffins topped with Canadian bacon, perfectly poached eggs, and silky Hollandaise sauce. This elegant brunch favorite is finished with refined garnishes for a restaurant-quality presentation.

ingredients.title: For the Hollandaise Sauce
items: ½ cup (115 g) unsalted butter, melted and warm
Pinch of cayenne pepper or white pepper
(Optional) ½ tsp white wine vinegar reduction for extra depth

ingredients.title: For the Base
items: 2 English muffins, halved and lightly toasted
4 slices Canadian bacon or smoked ham (alternatively, pancetta or prosciutto)

ingredients.title: For Garnish (Restaurant Touch)
items: A drizzle of truffle oil (optional, for luxury plating)

instruction.title: 1. Make the Hollandaise
steps: In a stainless-steel bowl, whisk egg yolks and lemon juice until pale and slightly thickened.
Place the bowl over a pot of simmering water (bain-marie). The bottom should not touch the water.
Whisk constantly while slowly drizzling in the warm melted butter.
Continue whisking until the sauce is thick, smooth, and glossy.
Add salt, white pepper, and a touch of cayenne.
Keep warm (around 55–60°C / 130–140°F) until service.
Chef's Tip: If the sauce thickens too much, whisk in 1 tsp of warm water to loosen it.

instruction.title: 2. Poach the Eggs
steps: Bring water and vinegar to a gentle simmer (not a boil).
Crack each egg into a small bowl.
Swirl the water to create a vortex and slide in one egg at a time.
Poach for 2½–3 minutes for a soft center.
Remove with a slotted spoon, drain on a paper towel, and trim edges neatly for clean presentation.
Chef's Tip: Use only very fresh eggs—the whites will hold shape beautifully.

instruction.title: 3. Prepare the Base
steps: Toast English muffins until golden brown.
Lightly butter each half.
Pan-sear or warm the Canadian bacon until slightly caramelized.

instruction.title: 4. Assemble the Dish
steps: On each plate, place two muffin halves.
Top each with a slice of bacon, then a poached egg.
Spoon warm Hollandaise generously over the top.
Garnish with microgreens, a dusting of paprika, and a drizzle of truffle oil for an elegant finish.

servingSuggestions.title: Suggested Pairing
items: Drink: Classic Mimosa or a crisp Sauvignon Blanc.
Side: Sautéed asparagus tips or truffled potato rösti.

chefTips: Serve on a pre-warmed white porcelain plate.
Spoon the sauce in a controlled pour — don't drown the egg.
Add a few dots of chive oil or balsamic glaze on the side for visual contrast.
A small salad of baby greens dressed with lemon vinaigrette pairs beautifully.
